roe.text: The Eye of Ugin is where Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the chamber, sealing it with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath.
Millennia later Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye, and when Chandra and Jace confront him there, Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa shatters the main hedron and releases the Eldrazi titans, and Sorin leaves the plane.

m12.text: The Eye of Ugin draws both Chandra and Jace after Chandra steals a scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai and Jace is hired to recover it.

bfz.text: The Eye of Ugin is where Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace meet, arranged by Nicol Bolas, and unknowingly reactivate it, and when Sorin and Nissa come to seal it, Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
Jace descends into the ruined Eye and meets Ugin, who tells him that the Eldrazi cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning them again, while he insists on saving Zendikar's people as well.
Privately realizing that the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi into the physical realm so they could be killed, Jace agrees to Ugin's demands but leaves the Eye with a plan of his own.
